MEAT.description: Raw flesh harvested from a butchered corpse. Best cooked before eating -- devouring it raw risks poison or worse.

POTION_FERAL_DRAUGHT.description: A toxic brew that boosts strength.

BRASS_LANTERN.description: A sturdy brass lantern. Casts steady golden illumination and wards off deep shadows.

HOME_ALTAR.description: An ancient stone altar humming with banked Divinities. Spend them here on permanent upgrades to your next expedition.

ANCIENT_FOSSIL.description: A stone imprint of a creature.

RUSTY_SWORD.description: A corroded blade. Better than nothing.

CERAMIC_SHARD.description: A piece of a broken pot.

COOKED_MEAT.description: A piece of cooked meat. Smells delicious.

LOST_DIVINITIES.description: Spiritual essence lost upon death. Step over to reclaim.

MEAL.description: A prepared dish that provides sustenance and temporary boons.

RING_OF_PROTECTION.description: A shimmering ring that grants +1 to Armor Class and saving throws.

BOOTS_OF_ELVENKIND.description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound.

CLOAK_OF_PROTECTION.description: A fine elven cloak granting +1 to Armor Class and resistances.

WAND_OF_MAGIC_MISSILES.description: This wand has 7 charges to cast Magic Missile.

PERIAPT_OF_WOUND_CLOSURE.description: A mystical amulet that stabilizes dying heroes and doubles healing.

BAG_OF_HOLDING.description: An extradimensional bag that holds up to 500 lbs effortlessly.

POTION_OF_INVISIBILITY.description: Drinking this potion cloaks you in complete invisibility for 1 hour.

POTION_OF_HEROISM.description: Grants 10 temporary HP and the effects of the Bless spell.

SCROLL_FIREBALL.description: A scroll containing the Fireball incantation. Can be cast or scribed at camp.

SCROLL_MISTY_STEP.description: A scroll containing Misty Step. Can be cast or scribed at camp.

SCROLL_MAGIC_MISSILE.description: A scroll containing Magic Missile. Can be cast or scribed at camp.

SCROLL_LIGHTNING_BOLT.description: A scroll containing Lightning Bolt. Can be cast or scribed at camp.
